claim: The default quota of delivery (Firehose) streams per account depends on the Region: 5,000 in us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2, ap-northeast-1 and eu-west-1; 2,000 in us-west-1, ap-northeast-2, ap-south-1, ap-southeast-1, ap-southeast-2, ca-central-1, eu-central-1 and eu-west-2; 500 in ap-northeast-3, eu-north-1, eu-south-1, eu-west-3 and sa-east-1; and 100 in each of the other supported Regions. The quota is adjustable.
question: How many Firehose streams can one account create per Region by default, and can the quota be raised?

qualifiers.scope: Firehose streams per account, per Region
qualifiers.condition: the Adjustable column says Yes; raise it through Service Quotas
